summary: La Romaine Airport (ZGS) is a small regional airport serving the remote coastal community of Le Golfe-du-Saint-Laurent in eastern Quebec, Canada. Located on the Lower North Shore of the St. Lawrence River, it provides essential air connectivity for the Innu community of La Romaine (Unamen Shipu) and surrounding areas that are otherwise isolated by vast wilderness and limited road infrastructure. The airport plays a vital role in medical evacuations, supply delivery, and passenger travel to this remote region.
faqs:
Q: Where is La Romaine Airport located?
A: La Romaine Airport is situated near the community of La Romaine in the Le Golfe-du-Saint-Laurent municipality, on the remote Lower North Shore of Quebec, Canada, along the Gulf of St. Lawrence.

Q: What airlines serve La Romaine Airport?
A: The airport is primarily served by regional carriers that provide scheduled passenger service connecting remote Lower North Shore communities to larger hubs like Sept-Îles.

Q: Is La Romaine Airport open year-round?
A: Yes, the airport operates throughout the year, though winter weather can occasionally affect flight schedules in this northern coastal region.

Q: Are there facilities at the airport?
A: As a small regional airport, facilities are limited, but it supports essential services including passenger flights and medevac operations for the local community.
transport_tips: There is no road access to Le Golfe-du-Saint-Laurent from the rest of Quebec; travel to this airport is almost exclusively by air, making it the primary lifeline for the community. Ground transportation from the airport to the village is limited, so arranging pickup in advance with a local contact or accommodation is recommended. Travelers connecting through Sept-Îles should allow ample time between flights, as weather-related delays are common in this remote region.
local_tip: Pack snacks and entertainment for your flight, as the short regional hops along the Lower North Shore can sometimes be rerouted or delayed due to the unpredictable coastal weather patterns of the Gulf of St. Lawrence.
